title: Narrow carbon pentaheptite nanoribbon as a covalent metal
title_zh: 窄碳五七烯纳米带作为共价金属
abstract: Metallic carbon-based nanoribbons are sought after1,2 as atomically defined one-dimensional conductors with potential relevance to future carbon-based electrodes and interconnects3, ideally with quantum-limited conductance comparable to metallic carbon nanotubes4. Metallic graphene nanoribbons have been realized by band engineering, notably through zero-mode superlattices1. However, atomically precise metallic nanoribbons of fully non-benzenoid carbon allotropes, such as the theorized metallic carbon pentaheptites5,6, remain unexplored. The realization of these nanoribbons could enable bottom-up fabrication of all-carbon electronics7,8 compatible with semiconducting graphene nanoribbons9–13 and nanographenes14,15, along with their fascinating properties16–20. Here we report a hierarchical approach for the on-surface synthesis of planar carbon pentaheptite nanoribbons (CPHNs) by laterally fusing well-aligned polypentalene chains transformed from pre-synthesized polycyclooctadiene chains. Two distinct types of narrow pentaheptite nanoribbon share a similar basal structure consisting of a central heptagon chain flanked by either identically (CPHN 1) or differently (CPHN 2) oriented polypentalene chains on opposite lateral edges. CPHN 1 is an intrinsic metal, whereas CPHN 2 is a narrow-bandgap semiconductor. The CPHN 1 ribbon exhibits near-ballistic conductance approaching one conductance quantum, comparable to metallic carbon nanotubes4. This highlights CPHN 1 as a promising planar carbon metal and suggests a possible route towards carbon quantum wires, although further synthetic optimization will be required for device integration. Planar carbon pentaheptite nanoribbons are synthesized by laterally fusing polypentalene chains transformed from pre-synthesized polycyclooctadiene chains, suggesting a possible route towards carbon quantum wires.
abstract_zh: 金属性碳基纳米带因其作为原子精确的一维导体的潜力而备受追捧，尤其适用于未来碳基电极和互连，理想情况下可具有可比拟于金属性碳纳米管的量子限制导率。金属性石墨烯纳米带已通过带隙工程实现，尤其是通过零模式超晶格。然而，完全非苯并碳同素异形体（如理论预测的金属性碳五七烯）的原子精确金属纳米带尚未被探索。实现这些纳米带有望实现与半导体石墨烯纳米带及纳米石墨烯及其迷人特性兼容的全碳电子器件的自下而上制造。在此，我们报道了一种用于表面合成平面碳五七烯纳米带（CPHN）的层次化方法，通过侧向融合由预合成的环辛二烯链转化而来的排列良好的聚五元环链来实现。两种不同类型的窄五七烯纳米带共享相似的基底结构，由中央七元环链构成，其两侧两侧边缘分别具有方向相同（CPHN 1）或不同（CPHN 2）的聚五元环链。CPHN 1 是内在金属，而 CPHN 2 是窄带隙半导体。CPHN 1 带表现出接近一量子导电量的近弹道导率，可比拟于金属性碳纳米管。这突显了 CPHN 1 作为一种有前途的平面碳金属，并表明通往碳量子导线的可能路径，尽管器件集成还需要进一步的合成优化。通过将预合成的环辛二烯链转化为聚五元环链并侧向融合来合成平面碳五七烯纳米带，这表明了通往碳量子导线的可能路径。
